integrity: All universal assertions follow from explicit positive-semidefinite block inequalities. Exact witness evaluations and finite computations corroborate but do not replace proof. No external independent assessment has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Not a statewise equivalence between asymmetry and violation; axes are fixed and no preparation, noise, or implementation guarantee is asserted. Some mathematically equivalent semidefinite-program characterization may remain unindexed.
scientific_scope: All two-qubit density operators at fixed trace distance to their SWAP transform, with fixed Pauli CHSH observable B0.
title: Sharp exchange-asymmetry frontier for fixed-Pauli CHSH witnesses
